title: ITRS, ITRF, Epoch, and Plate-Motion Semantics
negative_results: an EpochStampedPoint cannot be built without an epoch (TypeError)
an unknown ITRF realization is rejected (FrameError)
a plate-motion velocity that is not three finite components is rejected
make_certificate rejects an unknown frame or an empty orientation_profile_id

claims.statement: An Earth coordinate is epoch-stamped; the same point at epoch t1 differs from epoch t2 by exactly the modelled linear plate drift, and the propagation is reversible.
Named ITRF realizations (ITRF2008/2014/2020) are preserved as versioned interpretations; the plate-motion model is a declared MODEL, not a measurement.

runlog.inputs: none; epochs and velocities passed in as decimal years / metres-per-year, no wall-clock read
runlog.assumptions: epoch is decimal-year, time scale TT_DECIMAL_YEAR; linear constant-velocity plate motion
runlog.boundary: public code, synthetic plate velocities only
runlog.schema_validation: FrameEpochCertificate validated against cwatlas/schemas/frame_epoch.schema.json via jsonschema
unresolved_questions: a real ITRF-to-ITRF Helmert transform (14 parameters) is out of scope; only the epoch/drift semantics are modelled here

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
